3.The man standing next to the New-
tonville Loudonville Stage (pg. 2) is
David Jeram from Newtonville. He ran
the stage company. The color post card
photograph of the Menands Station and
several others of the immediate area in
Menands were taken by a fellow named
S.Y. Ferguson who was the Station Agent
at the Menands RR Station in the early
20th Century according to Census and
city directories. Ferguson had a pros-
thetic leg as a result of an injury working
in a local railyard where he lost his leg.
His name was found on advertisements
(see image above right) proclaiming the
wonders of his artificial leg which he
said allowed him to do almost anything
again. Ferguson is buried in the Albany
Rural Cemetery.

We are rapidly approaching the end of another
year for the Historical Society. Fortunately we
are moving toward more normal times after the
limitations of our multi-year COVID experience.
What a couple of years it has been!
